subject: Television & Streaming
title: Telenovelas and Social Change
description: A 60-second lesson on Telenovelas and Social Change.

hook.text: Brazilian telenovelas have influenced real social behavior.

buildup.text: Researchers found that telenovelas lowered Brazil's fertility rate.

discovery.text: This phenomenon is called 'entertainment-education.' Embedding social messages in popular narratives changes behavior.

climax.text: Latin American telenovelas are proof that television's influence extends far beyond entertainment.

punchline.text: A soap opera changed how many children a nation had.

quiz.question: What is 'entertainment-education' in the context of telenovelas?
options: Embedding social messages in popular narratives to change real-world behavior
